raw_callback.review_note:
Independent read-only review. Recomputed hashes, not trusted summaries: remote-prepare.txt (8a7593d0...), local-browser-v2/evidence.json (836b48db...), publish-prepared-preview.sh (b2905b8b...) and the package archive (10e62998...) all match execution-packet.json. Frozen commit e437661 is merge-base ancestor of HEAD; `git diff <frozen>..HEAD -- next quizzes metadata study/question_articles` is empty (HEAD==frozen commit now).

Traced scripts, not just logs. remote-prepare-script.sh matches prepare_remote.py's generated guard+upload+extract+checksum+syntax-check; DEPLOY.lock is held only for that phase and released before `cutover.sh prepare` (own lock). cutover.sh checks baseline image/PVC before touching anything, verifies checksums.txt and api/main.dart.js hashes, asserts version.json metadata, then runs backup_sqlite.py + a per-run-renamed copy of rehearse.py against a fresh sandbox (never the raw 'rehearsal-final'/backup path). In rehearse.py: old_rows[t]<=current and equal counts for every table except attempt_bundles (+131) is asserted right after API startup, before any synthetic writes -- this is exactly what original/post_migration_counts in the log measure, so 'original rows preserved' is checked at the point that matters. Grading is exercised end-to-end for all 8 runtime quizzes (feedback.correct==True) and cross-checked against the controller's own expected-staging-revisions.json. NewYear: 53 untouched rows hash-verified, 2 corrected rows checked by id/answer/reveal; 55+140=195 total graded matches spec. Feedback lifecycle only hits the private rehearsal port, never production. Old-API rollback re-exercises the prior immutable binary against the migrated sandbox DB and re-reads /v1/history (len 9 = 8+1 NewYear) and one attempt byte-for-byte -- a real compatibility check.

publish_prepared.py/publish-prepared-preview.sh: script body is cutover.sh's prefix (identity/lock/checksum/backup/rehearsal) verbatim up to the build line, diff-confirmed byte-identical, plus a tail that only re-verifies the recorded durable-archive hash, confirms image presence via `k3s ctr images ls` (no re-import), re-runs helm lint/template/dry-run against the same recorded digest, then `helm upgrade --atomic --wait --timeout 180s` + public version.json/JS-hash check. No docker build/save/import anywhere in the generated script -- it cannot rebuild. What actually ran was remote `bash -n` syntax-only (--preview short-circuits via SystemExit(0)); no publish.txt/publish-exit.json/execution-acceptance.json exist, confirming no real upgrade and no fabricated acceptance record. Real publish requires execution-acceptance.json with actual_hub_state=='ACCEPTED' matching package_sha256/image -- that file doesn't exist yet, so publication cannot proceed until this review is faithfully recorded there.

No material defect found. One non-blocking note: the publish gate is a local-file check, not a live hub query, so its integrity depends on the lead correctly transcribing this verdict -- consistent with HOST_HUB's single-OS-account trust boundary, but worth double-checking before use.

LIMITS: read-only; did not SSH/execute/build/test/browse myself, relied on retained logs/scripts/recomputed hashes. Did not certify whole-bank facts, Android devices, keyboard fidelity, or screen readers. Did not witness actual publication.
